notes: This paper derives a PREFERRED (hinted) region for the axion-electron coupling from a global fit to stellar cooling anomalies (WD+RGB+HB), not an exclusion limit or sensitivity projection. Best-fit g_ae = 1.6e-13 (range 1.26e-13 to 1.89e-13), mass-independent up to ma ~ few keV per footnote 2. Because it is a favored region rather than an upper limit, is_new_limit is set false and confidence is low. The paper mainly presents model-dependent fit contours (DFSZ, KSVZ A/J) in coupling planes and projected sensitivities for IAXO/ARIADNE, which are external projections not derived here as exclusion data.
